My sister cut contact with me a little over 2 years ago. I never knew exactly why. It hurt a lot, but it lasted for so long that I honestly thought she'd never speak to me again, and I came to terms with it and lived my life without her.

Recently, she's started talking to me again. We've agreed that what's done is done, and it'll all remain in the past. This is probably for the best because bringing up the fact that I have no clue what angered her to the point of practically disowning me, would probably just cause more arguments. The trouble is, she's just behaving as though nothing has happened. I really don't know how to re-adjust to this. I'm glad to have my sister back, but I don't know how to deal with going from 2 years of stony silence to suddenly my sister loves me again and all is forgiven.

I'm ranting, and this is probably boring, but I needed to talk about it with someone who hasn't been involved at all.

She's 23, and I'm 25, for context. Also, her boyfriend and I clash. I think this has something to do with it, but I can't see that this would be the entire reason.

Edit: Thank you guys for your kinds words and advice. I've decided to just forgive and forget, and move on. I'm glad to have this wonderful opportunity to reconnect with my sister, and I'm going to focus on what's to come, not what's already been, to build a brighter future :)

Hey, there.

I'm a CSS guy, so I like commenting on people's designs. I took a look at /v/Android and, if I may, I have a few criticisms!

  • The color scheme

    Pink seems a little odd as a main color, especially for a subverse about phone operating systems. I've never owned an Android phone, so I admit I may be the ignoramus here, but the first thing I think of when I go there is "girly diary" [Edit: "girly wallpaper", since diaries are white paper, most of the time.]. I blame society conformity, mostly.

  • Voting arrows

    The arrows stand out a lot and they look dreadful, like they were made with paint in five seconds. I don't blame you, though, if you're not much of a graphics artist.

    Mostly, though, it's that the arrows aren't on a spritesheet. When voting, the arrows 'blink' while the browser loads the next image. Web designers get around this by using an image array of a whole bunch of icons, called a spritesheet.

Other than that, I think it could be better as you add more things to it. Good luck! :-)
